MANDARIN — MOCK EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which final is written with two dots on top? (1 mark)
   A. ü
   B. e
   C. u
   D. o

2. Which initial is said WITHOUT a puff of air? (1 mark)
   A. d
   B. p
   C. k
   D. t

3. Which sentence is a correct answer to 这是谁? (1 mark)
   A. 这是我妈妈。
   B. 我在家。
   C. 电视在哪儿?
   D. 这是什么?

4. Which word means "younger sister"? (1 mark)
   A. 妈妈 māma
   B. 妹妹 mèimei
   C. 女儿 nǚ'ér
   D. 姐姐 jiějie

5. What does 哥哥 (gēge) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Daughter
   B. Is, am, are
   C. Older brother
   D. Love

6. What does 客厅里有电视 mean? (1 mark)
   A. There is a television in the living room
   B. The television is in the kitchen
   C. The living room is on the television
   D. I like television

7. Fill the blank: 冰箱____厨房。 (The fridge is in the kitchen.) (1 mark)
   A. 有
   B. 上
   C. 是
   D. 在

8. What does 九 (jiǔ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Eight
   B. Nine
   C. Two
   D. Four

9. Which Chinese word means "happy"? (1 mark)
   A. 快乐 kuàilè
   B. 祝 zhù
   C. 月 yuè
   D. 蛋糕 dàngāo

10. What does 你生日是几月几号? ask? (1 mark)
   A. What is your favourite food?
   B. When is your birthday?
   C. What is your name?
   D. Where do you live?

11. Which Chinese word means "to sing"? (1 mark)
   A. 盘子 pánzi
   B. 礼物 lǐwù
   C. 快乐 kuàilè
   D. 唱歌 chànggē

12. Which Chinese word means "spinach"? (1 mark)
   A. 米饭 mǐfàn
   B. 菠菜 bōcài
   C. 水果 shuǐguǒ
   D. 水 shuǐ

13. Which of these is a staple food that gives the body energy? (1 mark)
   A. 咖啡 coffee
   B. 米饭 rice
   C. 水 water
   D. 茶 tea

14. Which Chinese word means "banana"? (1 mark)
   A. 早饭 zǎofàn
   B. 菠菜 bōcài
   C. 晚饭 wǎnfàn
   D. 香蕉 xiāngjiāo

15. Which sentence means "This is my older sister"? (1 mark)
   A. 这是我妹妹。
   B. 这是我爸爸。
   C. 这是我姐姐。
   D. 那是我弟弟。

16. Fill the blank: 这是____? (Who is this?) (1 mark)
   A. 什么
   B. 哪儿
   C. 谁
   D. 几

17. What does 在 (zài) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Living room
   B. Kitchen
   C. Is at, is in
   D. Door

18. What does 放 (fàng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Things
   B. To put
   C. Is at, is in
   D. Beside

19. What does 四 (sì) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Nine
   B. Six
   C. Four
   D. Three

20. What does 十二月十二号 mean? (1 mark)
   A. 12 January
   B. 2 October
   C. 12 December
   D. 10 December

21. What does 米饭 (mǐfàn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Cooked rice
   B. Fruit (as a group)
   C. Mango
   D. Banana

22. Which word means "snacks"? (1 mark)
   A. 饮料
   B. 零食
   C. 水果
   D. 蔬菜

23. Fill the blank: 我家有五____人。 (There are five people in my family.) (1 mark)
   A. 只
   B. 口
   C. 号
   D. 两

24. Which part is common to the characters 妈, 姐 and 妹? (1 mark)
   A. 未
   B. 马
   C. 女
   D. 且

25. Which sentence means "There are five people in my family."? (1 mark)
   A. 我家有五口人。
   B. 那是我哥哥。
   C. 我爱你。
   D. 这是我姐姐。

26. Why is correct spelling with tones important? (1 mark)
   A. Only capital letters matter
   B. Tones do not matter
   C. Only characters matter
   D. A wrong tone can change the meaning

27. Which sentence means "Today is Wednesday"? (1 mark)
   A. 明天是星期一。
   B. 今天是星期天。
   C. 今天是星期三。
   D. 昨天是星期三。

28. What does 菠菜 (bōcài) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Dinner
   B. Mango
   C. Apple
   D. Spinach

29. Which sentence means "Today it rains."? (1 mark)
   A. 今天天气很好。
   B. 今天下雨。
   C. 这是太阳。
   D. 风很小。

30. Which Chinese word means "window"? (1 mark)
   A. 桌子 zhuōzi
   B. 电视 diànshì
   C. 窗户 chuānghu
   D. 厨房 chúfáng

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "And you?" (2 marks)

32. Name one kind of extreme weather. Say what causes it and give one safety tip. (4 marks)

33. Write a short dialogue of four lines in Chinese with pinyin: two friends greet each other and one says it is their birthday. (4 marks)

34. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "On Sunday, go to church." (3 marks)

35. Blend the syllables zhuō and zi and give the meaning. (2 marks)

36. Draw a plan of a home with a garden, door, window and sofa and write four sentences about where things are, in Chinese with pinyin. (5 marks)

37. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 月 and 太阳. (2 marks)

38. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Tomorrow is Thursday." (3 marks)

39. Explain one similarity and one difference between naming the days in Kiswahili and Chinese. (4 marks)

40. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 妹妹 and 米饭. (2 marks)

41. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The door is on the left." (2 marks)

42. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 刷牙, 手 and 生日. (3 marks)

43. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "What is this?" (2 marks)

44. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: wǒ yǒu liǎng zhī yǎnjing. (2 marks)

45. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: xièxie! (2 marks)

46. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 喝 and 牙. (2 marks)

47. Punctuate the sentences: 你好 (greeting), 我叫小明 (statement), 你呢 (question). Write the full sentences. (2 marks)

48. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 脚 and 休息. (2 marks)

49. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The wind is very light." (2 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — MOCK EXAM #4 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — ü
   The lips-rounded sound ee is written ü, with two dots.

2. A — d
   d is unaspirated. t, k and p are said with a puff of air.

3. A — 这是我妈妈。
   谁 asks who, and the answer names a person.

4. B — 妹妹 mèimei
   妹妹 is a younger sister and 姐姐 is an older sister.

5. C — Older brother
   哥哥 (gēge) means older brother.

6. A — There is a television in the living room
   里 is inside and 有 is there is.

7. D — 在
   在 means is at or is in.

8. B — Nine
   九 (jiǔ) means nine.

9. A — 快乐 kuàilè
   快乐 (kuàilè) means happy.

10. B — When is your birthday?
   月 is month and 号 is the date.

11. D — 唱歌 chànggē
   唱歌 (chànggē) means to sing.

12. B — 菠菜 bōcài
   菠菜 (bōcài) means spinach.

13. B — 米饭 rice
   Staple foods such as rice give energy.

14. D — 香蕉 xiāngjiāo
   香蕉 (xiāngjiāo) means banana.

15. C — 这是我姐姐。
   姐姐 is older sister.

16. C — 谁
   谁 means who.

17. C — Is at, is in
   在 (zài) means is at, is in.

18. B — To put
   放 (fàng) means to put.

19. C — Four
   四 (sì) means four.

20. C — 12 December
   十二月 is December.

21. A — Cooked rice
   米饭 (mǐfàn) means cooked rice.

22. B — 零食
   零食 língshí is snacks.

23. B — 口
   口 is used to count family members.

24. C — 女
   女 means woman or female.

25. A — 我家有五口人。
   我家有五口人。 (wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén.) means "There are five people in my family.".

26. D — A wrong tone can change the meaning
   chuáng and chuāng are different words.

27. C — 今天是星期三。
   今天 is today.

28. D — Spinach
   菠菜 (bōcài) means spinach.

29. B — 今天下雨。
   今天下雨。 (jīntiān xià yǔ.) means "Today it rains.".

30. C — 窗户 chuānghu
   窗户 (chuānghu) means window.

SECTION B
----
31. (2 marks)
   Answer: 你呢? nǐ ne?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

32. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example a flood: it is caused by too much heavy rain. Stay away from fast rivers. (A drought is caused by too little rain. Save water.)
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the event, 1 mark for the cause, 2 marks for a safety tip with a reason.

33. (4 marks)
   Answer: A: 你好! nǐ hǎo! B: 你好! nǐ hǎo! A: 今天是我的生日。 jīntiān shì wǒ de shēngrì. B: 祝你生日快乐! zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct line, with pinyin.

34. (3 marks)
   Answer: 星期天,去教堂。 xīngqītiān, qù jiàotáng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

35. (2 marks)
   Answer: zhuōzi, table.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the word and 1 mark for the meaning.

36. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example 门在左边。 mén zài zuǒbian. 沙发在门旁边。 shāfā zài mén pángbiān. 窗户在沙发上面。 chuānghu zài shāfā shàngmiàn. 花园在房子右边。 huāyuán zài fángzi yòubian.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the plan and 1 mark for each correct sentence.

37. (2 marks)
   Answer: 月: yuè, month. 太阳: tàiyáng, sun.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

38. (3 marks)
   Answer: 明天是星期四。 míngtiān shì xīngqīsì.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

39. (4 marks)
   Answer: Similarity: both use numbers to make day names. Difference: Chinese counts from Monday (星期一 is week one) but Kiswahili counts from Saturday (Jumatatu, Monday, has tatu, three).
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for the similarity and 2 marks for the difference with an example.

40. (2 marks)
   Answer: 妹妹: mèimei, younger sister. 米饭: mǐfàn, cooked rice.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

41. (2 marks)
   Answer: 门在左边。 mén zài zuǒbian.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: 刷牙: shuāyá, to brush teeth. 手: shǒu, hand. 生日: shēngrì, birthday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: 这是什么? zhè shì shénme?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: I have two eyes.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: Thank you!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: 喝: hē, to drink. 牙: yá, tooth.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: 你好! 我叫小明。 你呢?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the two correct marks, 2 marks for all three.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: 脚: jiǎo, foot. 休息: xiūxi, to rest.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: 风很小。 fēng hěn xiǎo.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.
